ApplicationInsights._Comment: Optional. When set, traces and metrics export to Azure Monitor/App Insights instead of the OTLP/console exporter. Blank by convention -- supply via the ApplicationInsights__ConnectionString environment variable, never commit it.

Pinecone._Comment: Host is the per-index data-plane URL from the Pinecone console (e.g. https://my-index-abc123.svc.us-east-1-aws.pinecone.io). Each project's collection maps to a Pinecone namespace within this one index.

Llm._Provider: Allowed values: "OpenAI" | "NvidiaNim" | "Ollama" | "Azure" | "Anthropic" | "Bedrock" — selects the chat/vision provider and which section below supplies its config
Llm._CheapChatModel: Optional per-provider override (e.g. Llm:NvidiaNim:CheapChatModel) used by Triage and the three verifiers instead of ChatModel. Unset = no tiering (same model everywhere). Validate judge quality with SupportForge.Evals before setting this to a smaller model — see docs/architecture/2026-08-06-003-gap-closing-solutions.md Phase C item 3.
Llm._FallbackProvider: Optional. Same allowed values as Provider above. When set, DrafterAgent's /query path fails over to this provider if the primary provider's circuit breaker is open (sustained outage) -- see docs/architecture/2026-08-06-003-gap-closing-solutions.md Phase C item 6. Unset = no fallback, current behavior.

Ollama._Comment: Self-hosted, open-source -- no ApiKey needed (Ollama's server ignores it). BaseUrl assumes `ollama serve` running locally.

Azure._Comment: BaseUrl is the Azure OpenAI resource endpoint; ChatModel/EmbeddingModel are deployment names, not model names

Anthropic._Comment: Chat and vision only — Anthropic has no embeddings API; set Embeddings:Provider to a different provider

Bedrock._Comment: Chat, vision, and embeddings via AWS SigV4 auth (no ApiKey — uses the host's AWS credential chain)

Embeddings._Provider: Optional. Set to a different provider (OpenAI | NvidiaNim | Ollama | Azure | Bedrock) when Llm:Provider lacks an embeddings API (Anthropic). Defaults to Llm:Provider.

Neo4j._Comment: Connection for the code knowledge graph (GraphImportJob writes it, GraphDbQueryTool queries it), scoped per project via the projectId node property.

Jwt._Comment: Key is blank here by convention (same as every LLM ApiKey above) — supply the real signing key via the Jwt__Key environment variable or user-secrets, never commit it.

GitHubWebhook._Comment: Shared secret configured on the GitHub repo/org webhook (Settings > Webhooks). Blank by convention -- supply via the GitHubWebhook__Secret environment variable, never commit it. Until set, POST /api/webhooks/github rejects every request with 503 rather than silently accepting unsigned payloads.

ConfluenceWebhook._Comment: Shared secret appended as ?secret=... to the webhook URL configured in Confluence (its webhook feature has no payload-signing mechanism to verify against, unlike GitHub's). Blank by convention -- supply via the ConfluenceWebhook__Secret environment variable, never commit it. Until set, POST /api/webhooks/confluence rejects every request with 503.

Freshness._Comment: How often ScheduledKbSyncService re-syncs non-webhook KB sources (Documents/Confluence/Website). Confluence/GitHub re-sync on their own webhooks instead when configured (see GitHubWebhook/ConfluenceWebhook above); this timer is the fallback for everything else, or when webhooks aren't set up.
Freshness._PollIntervalMinutes: How often the service checks which projects are due -- not how often any single project re-syncs. Keep this well below ScheduledSyncIntervalHours (and below any project's own override); 15min default gives roughly +/-15min accuracy on the actual sync cadence.

Drafter._GroundednessCheckEnabled: Optional, default false. When true, DrafterAgent runs a second LLM-judge call checking whether the draft's factual claims are supported by retrieved context, and halves confidence (doesn't block/replace the draft) if not. Validate with SupportForge.Evals against real model output before enabling -- see docs/architecture/2026-08-06-003-gap-closing-solutions.md Phase D item 3.

Guard._Mode: Off | Shadow | Enforce. Shadow scores and logs but never blocks; Enforce blocks block-class signals. Until the Jev client is configured the guard is heuristic-only and can only flag, never block. See docs/plans/2026-10-16-002-feat-jev-intent-classification-plan.md (Phase 3).

Triage._Classifier: Llm | Jev | Shadow. Llm is today's behaviour. Shadow runs Jev alongside the LLM, acts on the LLM and logs both (TriageShadow) for comparison. Jev acts on Jev with the LLM as fallback. Jev and Shadow need Jev:ApiKey. Thresholds are placeholders until the triage eval recommends values.

Verification._Judge: Llm | Jev | Shadow. Llm is today's behaviour. Shadow runs Jev alongside the LLM, acts on the LLM and logs both (VerifierShadow) for comparison. Jev acts on Jev with the LLM as fallback (VerifierJevFallback). Jev and Shadow need Jev:ApiKey. With Jev or Shadow, the customer question, recent history and KB snippet text are sent to TypeSafe, and code-graph snippets only when Verification:Jev:IncludeCode is true.
Verification._MinRelevance: Placeholder until the findings relevance eval (SupportForge.Evals, U10) recommends a value.
Verification._GroundednessPerSentence: Off by default. When true, DrafterAgent's groundedness check is judged per sentence by Jev (logs DrafterUnsupportedSentences). Turn it on only after reviewing Shadow traffic.

Jev._IncludeCode: Code-graph snippets (customer identifiers, file paths) go to TypeSafe only when this is true. Confirm the data-processing review covers source identifiers first.

Jev._ApiKey: Set via the Jev__ApiKey environment variable or a secret store, never in this file. Leave empty to keep every Jev-backed feature off.
